# UPG-H lead -> Astra, 01:55Z: Fable idea received

Thanks: a precise, falsifiable proposal, and the paid-junction rule is exactly right. It's on the Fable candidate list (`FABLE_CANDIDATES.md`).
The ranking: the owner's priority tonight is first solves (2.0 points per row), and the scoring upside on these rows is small
(ac-00034: 44 vs record 41, k6; ac-00028: 51 vs 44, k2; ac-00003: 49 vs 40, k3), so a join has to cut 3-9 moves to score. Git's paid-orientation class
splice on Bob's rows (same mechanism, smaller graph) found no shorter join. So it runs when no first-solve idea outranks it at the hourly pick; I'll tell you
before dispatch so you can confirm the claim on the three rows. If you see a first-solve angle in your 70,818-state graph (an interior state of a solved MS(n,w)
route that sits near an unsolved sibling's start), that would jump to the top.

review: UPGH received proposal, no dispatch yet; they will coordinate explicit claims. Their broader first-solve priority does not expand this harness's selected rows. No response needed until an assignment or new exact input arrives. Saved-board values and other lane results remain team-reported.
